commits.message:
feat(workflow): auto-create branch in plan-task, guard branch in implement-task

- plan-task Phase 1: run branch-manager.sh <N> immediately after ticket
  resolution — creates apim-<N> or switches to it (with stash safety)
- implement-task Phase 1: halt with warning if current branch doesn't
  match the ticket number in task-state.md

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(docs): correct install command, strip ASSESSMENT duplication, fix reviewRounds description

- Install command was ./dev-workflow, should be . (plugin root is repo root)
  Fixed in README.md, CLAUDE.md, and Day 1 walkthrough
- ASSESSMENT.md rewrote from 393 → 141 lines: removed "Problem Being Solved" and
  "Design Strategy" sections (verbatim README duplicates), stripped per-dimension
  "What the code actually does" narrative (covered in README Architecture/Agents),
  kept only scored analysis, caveats, field-by-field analytics table, and composite
- README.md Analytics table: reviewRounds description updated to reflect Bug 2 fix
  (was "CHANGES_REQUESTED + APPROVED... 1 clean review = 2 events"; now "0 = clean,
  1+ = rework cycles"); Design Trade-offs section updated to match

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workflow): trim CLAUDE.md, fix 3 bugs, add 5 improvements (7.6 → 8.3)

CLAUDE.md (188 → 117 lines, ~375 tokens/session saved):
- Collapse Skills and Hooks tables to one-liners referencing README.md
- Remove duplicated Output contract, lib/ section, task-state.md example, Why-markdown
- Compress Quality Gate to single paragraph; retain Format contract + Analytics intact
- Update filesChanged and reviewRounds descriptions to reflect bug fixes

Bug fixes:
- filesChanged now per-session via rev-list --after + root-commit parent guard;
  fallback to merge-base when no commits this session (session-terminator.sh)
- reviewRounds counts CHANGES_REQUESTED only — clean PRs show 0, not 2
  (was incorrectly counting APPROVED as a review round)
- NEXT step extraction scoped to current wave section via sed range;
  two-stage fallback handles last wave with no following header (session-loader.sh)

Improvements:
- plan-task Phase 2: live module inventory + transitive dep check; injected into
  task-planner prompt as Live Module Layout overriding static table
- implement-task: Unexpected GREEN → structured two-step check (git log pre-existence
  + assertion quality review)
- implement-task Phase 4.5: code-reviewer enriched with APIM-contextual reasoning;
  silent-failure-hunter adds RxJava3 reactive chain patterns (subscribe/flatMap/fromCallable)
- session-reviewer: N-1 session displayed before Last for magnitude comparison
- plan-task Phase 6b: design validator emits visible attribution line

ASSESSMENT.md: all scores updated (composite 7.6 → ~8.3)
Tests: 195/195 pass

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: remove test-e2e directory and stale references

The test-e2e/ directory was an asciinema recording guide, not an
automated test suite. It was not run in CI, produced no assertions,
and added ~1,200 lines of maintenance burden. The 195-test unit suite
in test-hooks.sh covers all hook behaviors it claimed to demonstrate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: gravitee-dev-workflow v1.0.0 — hooks, skills, metrics, TDD workflow

Complete Claude Code plugin for Gravitee APIM engineers:
- 6 skills: hello, install-tools, install-plugins, install-mcp-servers, plan-task, implement-task
- 3 session hooks: session-reviewer (metrics to stderr), session-loader (context to stdout), session-terminator (JSONL metrics)
- branch-manager.sh standalone utility with stash safety
- Wave-based TDD workflow with pre-commit quality gate (code-reviewer + silent-failure-hunter + type-design-analyzer)
- Session analytics: 14-field JSONL, trend arrows, branch compliance, rating
- E2E recording guide with fixture Maven project

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
